en.summary: Fixes CSR-unit stall and commit protocol so input hazards, output backpressure, and CSR writes are handled consistently.
why_it_counts: The real behavioral fix is in VX_csr_unit.v, a central control-path RTL module.
The patch separately models input-side hazard stall and output-side backpressure stall instead of conflating them.
CSR state writes are newly qualified by a valid pipeline response, which directly affects architectural state updates.
disqualifiers: VX_scoreboard.v and simulator changes in the same commit are diagnostic or observability-only, not the core fix.
evidence: VX_csr_unit.v adds write_enable = csr_pipe_rsp_if.valid && csr_we_s1 before writing VX_csr_data.
The old single stall signal is split into stall_in for fpu_pending and stall_out for response backpressure.
pipe_reg now stalls only on stall_out, while csr_pipe_req_if.ready becomes ~(stall_out || stall_in).

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This fix repairs a control-path protocol bug in a serialized CSR pipeline. The buggy form used one combined stall for both input-side dependency blocking and output-side backpressure, and it allowed CSR architectural state to be written based on a carried control bit even when no valid response was present. That can leave the scoreboard or issue logic stalled unnecessarily, or commit a CSR write on the wrong cycle.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: serialized CSR request, response, and commit handshaking
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A new CSR request arrives while the destination warp has an FPU-related dependency, while the CSR response path is backpressured, or while a carried write-enable bit survives without a matching valid response.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Conflate input hazard stall with output backpressure stall and allow CSR writeback to depend only on the carried control bit instead of on response validity.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: merge distinct stall domains and drop valid qualification on CSR state write
portability_notes: Map this to any serialized control pipeline where request acceptance, output hold, and state commit happen in different handshake domains.
The essential bug is mixing these handshake domains so a downstream stall can block upstream launch incorrectly, or a stale control bit can update state without a real response.
This is broader than CSR specifically; the same pattern applies to any side pipeline that reads and writes architectural state.
concrete_injection_steps: Replace separate input-hazard and output-backpressure stall signals with one combined stall condition.
Use that combined stall both to stop incoming requests and to hold the internal response register, instead of distinguishing the two cases.
Drive state write-enable directly from the carried operation bit, without additionally requiring the corresponding response-valid signal.
Leave the surrounding scoreboard or pending bookkeeping intact so the fault shows up as a stall or commit-protocol bug.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSR unit request readiness, pipe-register stall, and CSR-data write-enable
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit splits stall_in and stall_out, qualifies request validity with !stall_in, stalls the response register only on stall_out, and gates CSR writes with csr_pipe_rsp_if.valid.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_csr_unit, collapse stall_in and stall_out back into one stall signal, drive the pipe register with that combined stall, restore csr_pipe_req_if.ready to ~stall, and change write_enable back to csr_we_s1.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The issue path can remain stalled behind CSR traffic or FPU dependencies longer than necessary, or CSR state can be updated without a matching valid response, causing hangs, bad pending tracking, or incorrect CSR sequencing.
evidence_for_injection: The fix changes both handshake partitioning and CSR write qualification in one place, VX_csr_unit.v.
The scoreboard file only adds stronger assertions and messages, which supports the interpretation that the real bug was upstream in the CSR unit.
The commit subject explicitly names a scoreboard stall symptom, and the CSR-unit changes provide the only behavioral mechanism for it.
notes: If only one mutation is needed, dropping csr_pipe_rsp_if.valid from CSR write_enable is the smallest architectural-state corruption variant.
If the target DUT has no CSR scoreboard, use the stall-domain conflation variant instead.

zh.summary: 该修复统一了 CSR 单元的 stall 与提交协议，使输入依赖、输出反压和 CSR 写回处理保持一致。
why_it_counts: 真正的行为修复位于 VX_csr_unit.v，这是一个核心控制路径 RTL 模块。
补丁把输入侧依赖 stall 和输出侧 backpressure stall 分开建模，而不再混为一谈。
CSR 状态写入现在必须同时满足有效响应存在，这会直接影响架构状态更新。
disqualifiers: 同一提交中的 VX_scoreboard.v 和 simulator 变化主要是诊断或可观测性增强，不是核心修复。
evidence: VX_csr_unit.v 在写 VX_csr_data 之前新增了 write_enable = csr_pipe_rsp_if.valid && csr_we_s1。
旧的单一 stall 信号被拆成了用于 fpu_pending 的 stall_in 和用于响应反压的 stall_out。
pipe_reg 现在只在 stall_out 时停住，而 csr_pipe_req_if.ready 变成了 ~(stall_out || stall_in)。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该修复针对串行化 CSR 流水线中的控制协议错误。缺陷版本把输入侧的依赖阻塞和输出侧的反压共用一个 stall，并且即使没有有效响应，也可能仅凭流水线中携带的控制位去更新 CSR 架构状态。这既可能让 scoreboard 或 issue 逻辑被不必要地长时间阻塞，也可能让 CSR 写回发生在错误的周期。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 串行化 CSR 请求、响应与提交的握手机制
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 当新的 CSR 请求到来时，目标 warp 仍有 FPU 相关依赖，或 CSR 响应路径正在被反压，或存在没有匹配有效响应但仍保留的写控制位。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把输入依赖 stall 和输出反压 stall 重新混在一起，并让 CSR 写回只依赖携带的控制位而不依赖响应有效信号。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 合并不同 stall 域，并去掉 CSR 状态写回上的 valid 限定
portability_notes: 可映射到任何串行化控制流水线，只要请求接收、输出保持和状态提交属于不同的握手域。
核心错误是混淆这些握手域，使下游 stall 错误阻塞上游发射，或让陈旧控制位在没有真实响应时更新状态。
这不局限于 CSR；任何读写架构状态的旁路流水线都适用。
concrete_injection_steps: 把独立的输入侧依赖 stall 与输出侧反压 stall 改回一个组合 stall 条件。
用这个组合 stall 同时阻止新请求进入并保持内部响应寄存器，而不是区分两种情况。
让状态写使能直接来自流水线中携带的操作位，不再额外要求对应的响应 valid。
周围 scoreboard 或 pending 记账逻辑保持不变，让故障表现为 stall 或提交协议错误。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSR 单元中的请求 ready、pipe-register stall 和 CSR 数据写使能
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交拆分了 stall_in 和 stall_out，用 !stall_in 限定请求有效，只在 stall_out 时保持响应寄存器，并用 csr_pipe_rsp_if.valid 对 CSR 写入进行门控。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_csr_unit 中，把 stall_in 和 stall_out 合并回单一 stall，让 pipe register 使用该组合 stall，把 csr_pipe_req_if.ready 改回 ~stall，并把 write_enable 改回 csr_we_s1。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: issue 路径可能被 CSR 流量或 FPU 依赖过度阻塞，或者在没有匹配有效响应时仍更新 CSR 状态，导致挂起、pending 跟踪错误或 CSR 顺序错误。
evidence_for_injection: 修复同时改动了握手划分和 CSR 写门控，而且都集中在 VX_csr_unit.v。
scoreboard 文件只增加了更强的断言与报错信息，这反过来说明真实行为缺陷在上游 CSR 单元。
提交标题明确给出了 scoreboard stall 症状，而 CSR 单元改动提供了唯一的行为机制。
notes: 如果只需要一个最小变异，去掉 CSR write_enable 上的 csr_pipe_rsp_if.valid 是最小的架构状态破坏版本。
如果目标 DUT 没有 CSR scoreboard，则优先注入 stall 域混淆这一变体。
